title: Scrolling workshop
description: « Étapes » in the course's folio style: a figure that builds up while the learner reads. The figure stays in view (beside the stages on wide windows, at the top on narrow ones) and each stage, as it crosses the middle of the window, inks its layer and its labels (harbour names, a bearing); the stages are numbered in Roman numerals on leaves of vellum. With reduced motion, or without the player, the figure shows complete beside the stages.
instructions: A steps block in scroll presentation with figure build: figureImage is the figure before the first stage, each item's image the layer that stage adds (drawn in the frame of figureImage); the stage's text must explain what its layer adds. labels are words over the figure, placed in % of it and tied to the stage (from 1) that inks them: keep them few and short.

presentation.description: scroll: the stages scroll beside the figure that builds up (the only presentation of this style).

figure.description: build: each stage's image is a layer added over figureImage.

side.description: Where the figure sits beside the stages on wide windows (start: before them, on the left in a left-to-right language; end: after them).

labels.description: Words over the figure, each appearing with its stage.

x.description: Horizontal position, in % of the figure.

y.description: Vertical position, in % of the figure.

stage.description: The stage (from 1, in the order of items) whose layer the label goes with.

tone.description: name and name-rubric: a harbour name written from its point (x, y), in black or red; note: a short italic note centred on its point.
